title: Loops: repeat an action and explain every iteration
goal: Repeat a finite action, trace an accumulator and test no-iteration input.
prerequisites: The preceding language lesson; saving, updating and launching your own infobase.
outcomes: Expose a reset error and explain termination.
sections: A loop repeats instructions according to a rule. Для Номер = 1 По 3 assigns counter values 1, 2 and 3 in turn. Each value produces one body execution. КонецЦикла closes the repeated part; the message after it is displayed once after all iterations.

The body between Цикл and КонецЦикла executes for each counter value. Сообщить afterwards is outside it. Moving the message inside shows intermediate 15, 30 and 45 rather than one total: a different observation even if accumulation is unchanged.

ВсегоМинут accumulates the periods already included. It starts at zero before the loop, then becomes 15, 30 and 45. The invariant “after k iterations the total is 15 × k” explains intermediate states and exposes the first incorrect step.

Initially zero periods are included and total zero. One iteration includes exactly one period. After k iterations the total therefore covers k periods of 15 minutes. If the trace first differs at iteration two, investigate that transition rather than substituting the final output.

Setting ВсегоМинут = 0 inside the body erases preceding work on every iteration and leaves 15. It is syntactically valid but wrong for the total. Identify initialization and accumulation as different operations.

Range 1..4 adds four periods; range 1..0 executes no body and retains initial zero. A bound of zero does not create an extra iteration for zero. Пока checks before its body, so an initially false condition can also produce no iterations.
The large engineering module remains supplementary. Execute this lesson’s short fragment with its own input and result. It tests in-memory arithmetic, not document persistence or database speed.

A finite Пока needs initialization, a test and a change approaching a false condition. Collections come later: Для Каждого traverses elements, but in-memory arithmetic is not automatically a document query. Прервать ends the loop; Продолжить skips the rest of one iteration.

mistakes: I reset the accumulator each iteration.
Initialize before repeating when a total is required.
It advances to the next iteration; Прервать ends the loop.
